Design Principles Interview Questions

SOLID and its cousins are asked three ways: as theory ("explain OCP"), as a code review ("which principle does this break?") and silently, as the lens a grader uses on your machine-coding solution. This page drills all three: 30 Q&As with company tags and sources, six fix-this-code drills whose code compiles and runs, and six scenario drills with weak and strong answers.
